text:
Type: patterned knit throw blanket
Use: light layering on a chair, sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, coastal, Scandinavian
Materials: soft woven knit, fringed ends
Colors: white, navy, light blue, teal
Shape: rectangular throw, horizontal bands of zigzag lines, diamonds and chevrons, short white fringe, light and thin
Feel: fresh, airy, relaxed
Goes with: cognac leather, white walls, grey rugs, blue accents; coastal, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.description: Imported The fun pattern, tonal blue coloring, and twisted fringe of this throw blanket can add cool style to any indoor space. A cotton-acrylic blend, this throw is comfortable as well as stylish. 60"L x 50"W Twisted, self tassels 1 throw blanket For best results, dry-clean.
